description: NASA’s Perseverance rover has achieved a major milestone by navigating Martian terrain using artificial intelligence alone. In December 2025, AI-generated routes guided the rover safely across Jezero Crater, proving that autonomous navigation can dramatically speed up exploration and increase scientific returns on future planetary missions.
title: AI Takes the Wheel as Perseverance Rover Navigates Mars on Its Own

description: Japan’s XRISM X-ray observatory has delivered the first detailed maps of hot gas swirling around supermassive black holes in the Virgo and Perseus galaxy clusters. The data reveal intense turbulence, like cosmic storms driven by black hole jets. This churning heats the gas, stopping it from cooling and collapsing into new stars, explaining why cluster cores remain surprisingly star-poor. These findings reshape our understanding of how galaxies evolve.
title: Astronomers Capture First Detailed View of Hot Gas Swirling Around Black Holes

description: Samsung’s Galaxy S26 series may launch at higher prices in Europe, according to a new report. The lineup is expected to debut on February 25, with sales likely from March 11. Leaked pricing suggests increases for most models, including the Galaxy S26 and S26+, while the Galaxy S26 Ultra 256GB may retain its predecessor’s price. Higher storage variants could cost more, and Samsung may drop 128GB options in Europe. Pre-order and carrier deals may offset increases.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+ and Galaxy S26 Ultra Leak Hints at Price Hike in Europe

description: Many of the latest Android smartphones in India offer larger batteries with support for both wired and wireless fast charging. Here are some of the top smartphones available in India with up to 100W fast charging support. The list includes the iQOO 15, Redmi Note 15 Pro+ 5G, OnePlus 11R 5G, Realme P4 Pro 5G, and Vivo X300 Pro. Compare other specifications like display, chipset and battery capacity before placing the order.
title: Best Smartphones in India With Up to 100W Fast Charging Support: iQOO 15, Redmi Note 15 Pro+ 5G, More

description: The under Rs. 2,000 TWS segment in India offers feature-rich earbuds with strong value for money. Options like the Realme Buds T310, OnePlus Nord Buds 3r, GoBoult Tenet, Boat Nirvana Crystl, and iQOO TWS 1e bring large drivers, active noise cancellation, low-latency gaming modes, dual-device connectivity, and app support. Long battery life, fast charging, and solid call quality make these earbuds suitable for students, first-time buyers, and users seeking affordable, everyday audio solutions.
title: Best TWS Earbuds Under Rs 2,000 in India: OnePlus Nord Buds 3r, GoBoult Tenet and More

description: iQOO 15 Ultra has been launched in China as the latest addition to the Chinese smartphone maker’s flagship smartphone lineup. The new handset is scheduled to go on sale in the country on February 6 via the Vivo China online store. It is offered in two distinct colourways, dubbed 2077 (Black) and 2049 (Silver). The phone is powered by Qualcomm’s flagship octa core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, which is built on a 3nm process. It is backed by a 7,400mAh battery. It features support for 100W wired and 40W wireless fast charging.
title: iQOO 15 Ultra Launched With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, 7,400mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Oppo Find N6 appears to be the next entrant in the brand's book-style foldable smartphone series. Ahead of the official launch, the phone was spotted in an NBTC listing. It was spotted with model number CPH2765. The listing shows that the smartphone supports GSM, WCDMA, LTE, and NR networks. It is tipped to come with an 8.12-inch LTPO UTG inner display and a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: Oppo Find N6 Arrives on NBTC Database, Global Launch Could Take Place Soon

description: Vivo V70 Elite has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform, giving a peek at what it might offer in terms of performance. The handset is listed on the website with the V2548 model number.  This comes soon after the company confirmed that the Vivo V70 Elite and the Vivo V70 will be launched in India soon. The Elite model will be powered by a Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 chipset, while the standard version will be equipped with a Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 SoC.
title: Vivo V70 Elite Visits Geekbench With Snapdragon 8s Gen 3, 12GB of RAM

description: GTA 6's physical release will not be delayed, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has clarified. Speaking after Take-Two's quarterly earnings call, Zelnick said that the company had no plans to push back the physical version of GTA 6. Last week, a rumour claimed that physical copies of the game might be delayed to avoid leaks.
title: GTA 6 Physical Copies Won't Be Delayed, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick Clarifies

description: Microsoft introduced a new marketplace to streamline content licensing between publishers and artificial intelligence (AI) developers on Tuesday. Dubbed Publisher Content Marketplace (PCM), the Redmond-based tech giant said the space will streamline the process of companies wanting to ethically source content for AI models, and publishers wanting a fair payment for AI usage.
title: Microsoft Introduces Content Marketplace to Help Publishers Get Paid For AI Usage

description: RentAHuman.ai is a new service that was launched by Alexander Liteplo, an Argentinian crypto engineer, on Monday. The platform allows AI agents to hire humans to perform real-life physical tasks on their behalf. Developers can use Anthropic's MCP (Model Context Protocol) to integrate their AI agents with the new platform to start renting humans. These AI agents can ask humans to deliver packages, drive people to places, pick up groceries from stores for others, and feed their pets when they are away from home.
title: Crypto Developer Launches RentAHuman.ai Service That Lets AI Agents Hire Humans to Perform Real-Life Tasks

description: The shares of publicly traded software and IT services companies in India and the US took a nosedive after Anthropic announced Claude Cowork, an artificial intelligence (AI) automation product for enterprises. As per reports, the markets in both countries came under pressure this week after new automation plug-ins for the platform were released. It is said that investors raised concerns about AI replacing the offerings of these companies.
title: Explained: How Claude Cowork Sparked a Software and IT Stock Sell-Off in India and US

description: Google is said to be working on new agentic features for Gemini. The APK teardown of the Google app version 17.4 beta reportedly reveals a new Gemini agentic feature known as “Get tasks done with Gemini". The Labs feature is reportedly shown with strings explaining that “Gemini can help with tasks, like placing orders or booking rides, using screen automation on certain apps on your device.”
title: Gemini Screen Automation Feature to Control Apps on Android Phones Spotted in Development

description: Netflix’s Maa Behen is a dark comedy thriller that mixes family drama with crime and chaos. Starring Madhuri Dixit and Triptii Dimri, the film explores secrets, strained relationships, and survival under pressure. Scheduled for release in 2026, it is one of Netflix India’s most intriguing upcoming originals.
title: Maa Behen OTT Release Confirmed: Where to Watch Madhuri Dixit Starrer Series Online?

description: Streaming from February 6, Maathru is a gripping scientific thriller that explores fear, manipulation, and hidden codes. With a high IMDb rating of 8.6/10 and a suspense-filled storyline involving kidnappings and a cult, the film marks a strong addition to Lionsgate Play’s thriller lineup.
title: Maathru OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch This Telugu Film Online?

description: Operation Safed Sagar is an upcoming series that is set to land on Netflix soon. The teaser of the series is out, and the plot will explore the role of the Air Force during the 1999 Kargil War.
title: Operation Safed Sagar OTT Release Revealed: Where to Watch it Online?

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 series is expected to be launched in India and the global markets this month. While the company has yet to confirm the handsets, the top-of-the-line Galaxy S26 Ultra has been sighted on a benchmarking website, which hints towards its imminent debut. The listing also reveals some of its key specifications. The purported Samsung handset is expected to arrive with Qualcomm’s flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, running on Android 16.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra International Variant Visits Geekbench With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC

description: Samsung may be preparing a global launch for a new foldable smartphone expected to debut as the Galaxy Wide Fold. A new report says that multiple SM-F971 variants have appeared in the GSMA IMEI database, suggesting launch across several regions. The device is believed to be a wider Galaxy Z Fold variant planned for 2026, with a larger, squarer display. Other reports suggest Samsung could produce up to one million units and launch it alongside the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Flip 8 later this year.
title: Samsung Galaxy Wide Fold Appearance on IMEI Database Suggests Global Launch Is on the Cards

description: The Tecno Pova Curve 2 5G is confirmed to be launched in India as the successor to the Pova Curve 5G, which was introduced in May 2025. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the company has officially announced the launch date of the upcoming handset, while also revealing its design. It has a redesigned camera island that leans more towards the unit on the Tecno Pova 7, rather than its predecessor, in terms of appearance. The Tecno Pova Curve 2 is teased in three colour options.
title: Tecno Pova Curve 2 5G India Launch Date Announced; Design, Colour Options Officially Revealed

description: The iPhone 18 lineup may not see any significant design changes this year. A Chinese tipster states that the design of the new iPhone models will remain largely unchanged, with Apple sticking to a familiar overall look. The company is said to focus on optimisation of the chipsets for the iPhone 18 series. Apple is expected to launch the iPhone 18 Pro models in September this year. The standard iPhone 18 could launch later.
title: Apple's iPhone 18 Series Unlikely to Introduce Notable Design Changes, Tipster Claims

description: Google Maps is reportedly working on a new artificial intelligence (AI) feature that will make editing a listing more accessible to users. As per the report, the Mountain View-based tech giant is trying to upgrade the “Suggest an edit” feature in the platform by integrating it with Gemini. This will open a conversational interface for users trying to change or correct information about any place or shop listed on Maps.
title: Google Maps Could Soon Let Users Edit Listings Using Gemini: Report

description: AMD believes the next-gen Xbox is on track to launch in 2027, despite reports of the next generation of consoles being delayed due to rising RAM costs. At the company's Q4 2025 earnings call, AMD Lisa Su talked about planned launches of Valve's Steam Machine and Microsoft's next console.
title: Next-Gen Xbox on Track to Launch in 2027, Chipmaker AMD Suggests

description: OnePlus Nord 6 will be launched globally in April, according to a tipster. The handset was earlier reported to arrive in select countries in March. However, the Chinese smartphone maker appears to have postponed the unveiling by a month due to unspecified reasons. Separately, the rumoured Nord 6 has been spotted on the Eurasian Economic Commission (EEC) certification database with the CPH2795 model number, hinting at an imminent arrival in select global markets. However, the company has yet to reveal whether the phone will be unveiled in India or not.
title: OnePlus Nord 6 Launch Timeline Leaked as Handset Bags EEC Certification

description: New renders of the Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 and Galaxy Buds 4 Pro have leaked online, offering an early look at their design and charging case. The images highlight an open-fit Galaxy Buds 4, a silicone-tipped Galaxy Buds 4 Pro, and a new rectangular case with a transparent lid. The earbuds are also tipped to gain new gesture controls and larger batteries, with a launch expected alongside the Galaxy S26 series on February 25.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds 4, Galaxy Buds 4 Pro Design, Transparent Case Spotted in Leaked Renders

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 series is rumoured to be launched later this month, comprising the Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+, and Galaxy S26 Ultra. Although the South Korean tech conglomerate is yet to confirm the arrival of its next-generation Galaxy S models, it has released a set of teaser videos that are believed to hint at the photography capabilities of the purported handsets. Samsung has teased improved zoom, low-light imaging and video capture on the Galaxy S26 models.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Photography Capabilities Teased Ahead of Galaxy Unpacked

description: Samsung Display is set to start mass production of its 8th-generation OLED A6 line in May, laying the groundwork for Apple’s first OLED MacBook expected in the fourth quarter. A new report claims the line will produce 14-inch and 16-inch OLED panels, with shipments targeting two million units this year. Meanwhile, another report suggests Apple is close to launching new M5 Pro and M5 Max MacBook Pro models, as low retail stock and recent software activity point to an imminent announcement.
title: Apple’s First OLED MacBook to Launch This Year as Samsung Display Plans A6 OLED Production: Report

description: Apple is adding more artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities in Xcode, its integrated development environment (IDE) for building apps across its platforms. The Release Candidate of Xcode 26.3 began rolling out for developers on Tuesday, and one of its biggest highlights is the support for agentic coding. The Cupertino-based tech giant is now letting AI agents access the platform and perform certain tasks, increasing the scope of task automation within the IDE.
title: Apple’s Xcode 26.3 Brings Agentic Coding Features With OpenAI Codex, Claude Agent Integration

description: Redmi Note 15 Pro+ 5G and Note 15 Pro 5G are now available for purchase in India, the Chinese smartphone maker announced on Wednesday. The two handsets are on sale in the country via the Xiaomi India online store, Amazon, and select offline retail stores. While the Redmi Note 15 Pro+ 5G is offered in Carbon Black, Coffee Mocha, and Mirage Blue colourways, the Note 15 Pro 5G is sold in Carbon Black, Mirage Blue, and Silver Ash shades. Both handsets sport 6.83-inch AMOLED displays.
title: Redmi Note 15 Pro+ and Redmi Note 15 Pro Go on Sale in India for the First Time: Price, Offers

description: A Russian retailer has allegedly listed the Galaxy S26 Ultra, revealing its design and colour options. The renders show the handset in four shades. The renders show the Galaxy S26 Ultra with a hole-punch display with slimmer bezels and rounded corners compared to the Galaxy S25 Ultra. It has a redesigned rear camera island. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra is expected to be unveiled on February 25 alongside the Galaxy S26 and the Galaxy S26+.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Renders Point to Four Colour Options, Slightly Refreshed Design

description: Samsung is planning to manufacture 3.5 million units of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 before the smartphone's anticipated launch in the second half of this year, according to a report. On the other hand, the South Korean tech giant might manufacture 3 million units of the Galaxy Z Flip 8, nearly 5,00,000 units less than the company's book-style foldable. Samsung has reportedly decided to do so as it anticipates the demand for the purported Galaxy Z Fold 8 to be higher.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Production Reportedly Prioritised Over Galaxy Flip 8 Model

description: Sony appears to be working on its next generation of Xperia smartphones. The upcoming lineup is expected to include two models — Sony Xperia 1 VIII and Xperia 10 VIII. Both handsets have now surfaced on a certification website, which hints towards their imminent launch in the global markets. Reports suggest that the Xperia 1 VIII could be powered by the flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip, while the Xperia 10 VIII may arrive as a mid-range model.
title: Sony Xperia 1 VIII, Xperia 10 VIII Reportedly Listed on IMEI Database; Might Launch in Japan, Europe and Asia

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is on course to launch on November 19, 2026, Take-Two Interactive said in its third-quarter FY 2026 earnings call on Tuesday. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick expressed confidence in the game's release date and revealed that Rockstar Games was gearing up to begin launch marketing for GTA 6 this summer.
title: Take-Two Reaffirms GTA 6 Launch Date, Says Rockstar Will Begin Marketing Push This Summer

description: Oppo Find X10 series is expected to be launched by the Chinese smartphone maker later this year. While the rumoured unveiling of the lineup is months away, leaks regarding its specifications and features have started surfacing online. Recently, a report highlighted that the Oppo Find X10 Pro will be equipped with a 200-megapixel primary camera and a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera on the back. Now, a tipster has leaked information about the chipsets of the rumoured Find X10 series. The standard model is said to feature a MediaTek Dimensity 9500+ SoC, while the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 series chips might power the Find X10 Pro models.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Series Will Feature MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Series Chipsets, Tipster Claims

description: Vivo’s upcoming Vivo X300e and Vivo X Fold 6 have been spotted on the GSMA IMEI database, according to a new report, suggesting active development. The Vivo X300e is expected to join the X300 lineup as a more affordable flagship option, similar to earlier FE and T models. Meanwhile, multiple listings for the Vivo X Fold 6 suggest different regional variants. While specifications remain unknown, earlier leaks hint at a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chip for the foldable.
title: Vivo X300e and Vivo X Fold 6 Reportedly Listed on IMEI Database, Could Launch Soon

description: An alleged image of the global variant of Xiaomi 17 Ultra surfaced on X. The leaked render of the handset reveals the phone in a white shade with the model number 2512BPNDAG. It has a large circular rear camera module with Leica branding. The camera module has dual LED flash and large sensors. The design of the phone is similar to the model launched in China in December last year.
title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra Global Variant Design Appears Identical to Chinese Model in Leaked Render

description: Apple on Wednesday announced the expansion of skill-building and training programmes for employees working across its supplier network. As per the Cupertino-based tech giant, this initiative is part of its ongoing efforts to support workforce development in regions where it has a significant manufacturing presence. It also announced the launch of a new education hub in India, designed to provide accessible training programmes that help workers build technical proficiencies.
title: Apple Launches New Education Hub, Expands Supplier Training Programmes in India

description: Apple introduced the iPhone 17 series during its annual launch event in September 2025, and among the myriad of upgrades was a new selfie camera that utilises a square sensor. A tipster claims that Oppo and Huawei could adopt and implement this imaging technology in their upcoming smartphones. While the former is expected to introduce it with its next-generation flagship lineup, the latter may bring it to photography-centric mid-handsets, too.
title: Oppo Find X10 Series, Huawei Mid-Range Phones Tipped to Adopt iPhone 17’s Centre Stage Selfie Camera
